prompt: Create ONE standalone professional technical textbook illustration for ONE article. Use case: scientific-educational. This is the complete image brief; ignore all publication, recovery, dashboard, edition, and other-story context. Subject: continuous quality assurance in an LLM application (NarrateAI pattern). Wide landscape 1200 x 630 canvas, pure white background, refined navy typography with restrained blue/teal/amber accents, crisp detailed semi-isometric vector engineering illustration. Explain the mechanism visually with a richly layered cutaway of a live response pipeline: a user query entering retrieval; a small annotated source-evidence stack; an orchestration junction routing to two model paths with a dashed failover route; streaming token segments on a conveyor; a parallel evaluator rail that checks those segments; a numerical fact-verification inset comparing answer values against source values; a composite quality decision; a reviewed answer leaving the pipeline. Distinguish main data flow, evaluation feedback, and failover with a small clear line legend. Make the whole drawing cohesive, polished and information-dense, with subtle depth, fine leader lines, purposeful nested components and 10 or more meaningful labels, not sparse boxes connected by arrows. Top title exactly 'Quality checks inside the live LLM workflow'. Labels may include 'Query', 'Retrieved evidence', 'Adaptive orchestration', 'Primary model', 'Failover model', 'Streaming response', 'Live evaluation', 'Verify source values', 'Composite check', 'Reviewed answer'. Small footer 'Conceptual architecture — validate thresholds, latency and evaluator bias'. No quantitative performance claims. All text legible, no overlapping labels, generous 35px safe margin. No people, robots, photos, logos, decorative props, status dashboards, publication statuses, dates, multi-story summaries or green completion checklists. Render the illustration itself, with no browser frame.
